owner_review.coverage: Complete SMP1–SMP13: original edge-star conditioning, full conditional weighted Bochner identity, polynomial first-moment matrix floor, complete deficit refinement, exact source Hessian provider, energy-dependent second-moment matrix upper bound, original covariance floor with all finite factors, and the exact SCR missing-trial receiver.
owner_review.strengthening: Actual full raw face covariance has a strictly positive polynomial matrix floor independent of total box volume and face count. The first-moment floor applies to all complex raw coefficients, including oscillating and growing families. Conditional links are allowed to be coupled.
owner_review.corrections: No earlier published error found. Shared-link gradient and coefficient21 Hessian results already exist in PVC,SF,FTC,HSF and are explicitly used as providers. The smooth-test refinement is compared with the stronger prior HSF bound; it is not claimed to supersede it.
owner_review.limitations: The polynomial covariance floor tends to zero on fixed smooth support and does not locate mass in the shrinking annulus. Actual cross-patch filtered matrices, full residual, reconstruction and smooth global no-gap remain active.
owner_review.diagnostic_scope: Symbolic finite constants and original-path limits; coupled positive two-factor densities with full Bochner cross terms, not Yang-Mills ground samples; exact full box Hessian tensors and complex coefficients; finite spectral and dependent-trial matrix fixtures.
owner_review.status: Complete proof and local reader checks accepted; remote verification recorded separately.
